_about: William Jones (1762-1846), Baptist historian: The History of the Waldenses, connected with a sketch of the Christian church from the birth of Christ to the eighteenth century, second edition corrected and greatly enlarged (London: Gale and Fenner, 1816, 2 vols). Volume numbers read off each title page. Named william-jones-waldenses because there are many William Joneses; the name check looks for 'William Jones'.
